label: If unable to do 10 chair rises, are you willing to do a test of 5 rises instead - at age 69 years
meta_rows: If unable to do 10 chair rises, are you willing to do a test of 5 rises instead - at age 69 years
Use charintrn15x as the derived variable to use.
cat_rows: During the clinic (or home) visit at age 60-64 years study participants were asked by the attending nurse whether they would be willing to be timed performing 10 chair rises.  If willing and able (reasons for inability included health reasons and equipment not available) one test of 10 chair rises was performed.
val_rows: Question not asked in postal home visit
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
